ctx.x: On banjo and uh... Clippard on drums. Chester was on... Chester was on bass. Yeah. And uh...Edmund Hall on clarinet. Yeah. Yeah. Say I'm at Mahal that's playing with Louis Armstrong.
You heard anything from Chester lately? He's still up there. No I haven't heard from George.
